title: Upgrade React Native 0.73 → 0.74: compileSdk 34 → 35
prompt: After upgrading this project from React Native 0.73 to 0.74, the Android build fails because RN 0.74 requires compileSdkVersion 35 (and targetSdkVersion 34 minimum). Fix android/build.gradle so the compileSdkVersion, buildToolsVersion, and targetSdkVersion are bumped to the RN 0.74 requirements (compileSdkVersion = 35, buildToolsVersion = "35.0.0", targetSdkVersion = 34). Return each changed file with its complete new content.

fixtures.src/config/app.ts:
export const APP_NAME = 'rn-bench-app';
export const APP_VERSION = '1.0.0';
